title.en: Illinois Becomes First US State to Mandate Independent Third-Party AI Safety Audits
title.zhHans: 伊利诺伊成为全美首个要求独立第三方 AI 安全审计的州

searchSummary.en: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker signed the nation's first law requiring independent third-party safety audits for large AI developers, with fines up to $3M for violations.
searchSummary.zhHans: 伊利诺伊州长 JB Pritzker 签署全美首个要求大型 AI 开发者进行独立第三方安全审计的法律，违规罚款最高 300 万美元。

summary.en: On July 6, 2026, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signed the AI Safety Measures Act (SB 315), making Illinois the first US state to require independent third-party safety audits of large AI developers. The law applies to companies with over $500 million in annual gross revenue developing frontier AI models. Requirements include: publishing explanations of catastrophic risk and mitigation plans, reporting critical safety incidents to the state within 72 hours, annual independent compliance audits by qualified third parties, whistleblower protections with anonymous internal reporting, and fines up to $1M for first violations and $3M for subsequent ones. Requirements take effect January 1, 2028. The bill gained bipartisan support and was endorsed by both Anthropic and OpenAI.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月6日，伊利诺伊州长 JB Pritzker 签署了 AI 安全措施法案（SB 315），使伊利诺伊成为全美首个要求大型 AI 开发者进行独立第三方安全审计的州。该法律适用于年总收入超过 5 亿美元、开发前沿 AI 模型的公司。要求包括：公布灾难性风险及缓解计划、72 小时内向州政府报告严重安全事故、由合格第三方进行年度独立合规审计、举报人保护及匿名内部报告机制、首次违规罚款最高 100 万美元、后续违规最高 300 万美元。要求于 2028 年 1 月 1 日生效。该法案获得两党支持，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 均表示支持。

narrative.en: As the Trump administration showed reluctance to regulate AI at the federal level, Illinois stepped in to fill what lawmakers viewed as a void. The AI Safety Measures Act (SB 315) represents the most prescriptive state-level AI regulation in the US. Unlike California's and New York's AI laws, Illinois's is the first to mandate independent audits — a requirement that forces companies to submit their safety practices to external, technically qualified examiners. The law targets 'covered AI developers' — large frontier AI labs — rather than all AI users, distinguishing it from the EU's broader approach. Notably, Anthropic and OpenAI both supported the legislation, signaling that major AI labs recognize value in establishing baseline safety standards. Illinois House Speaker Emanuel 'Chris' Welch captured the legislative mood: 'Decision-making on AI is too important to be left to the federal government or tech bros whose culture of move fast and break things is moving faster and faster and breaking more and more as it goes.' The law's 2028 effective date gives companies nearly 18 months to prepare compliance systems.
narrative.zhHans: 在特朗普政府表现得不情愿在联邦层面监管 AI 的情况下，伊利诺伊介入填补了立法者眼中的空白。AI 安全措施法案（SB 315）代表了美国最精细的州级 AI 监管。与加州和纽约的 AI 法律不同，伊利诺伊的法律是首个强制要求独立审计的——这一要求迫使公司将其安全实践交由外部有技术资质的审查员检查。该法律针对'受覆盖的 AI 开发者'——大型前沿 AI 实验室——而非所有 AI 用户，这使其区别于欧盟更广泛的方法。值得注意的是，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都支持该立法，表明主要 AI 实验室认识到建立基线安全标准的价值。伊利诺伊州众议院议长 Emanuel 'Chris' Welch 捕捉到了立法情绪：'AI 的决策太重要了，不能留给联邦政府或那些'快速行动、打破常规'文化的科技哥们，他们行动越来越快，破坏也越来越多。'该法律 2028 年的生效日期为公司提供了近 18 个月来准备合规系统。

description.en: First US state to mandate independent third-party AI safety audits. Sets a template for other states and potentially federal regulation. Creates a compliance infrastructure (auditor qualification standards, reporting mechanisms) that other jurisdictions can adopt.
description.zhHans: 首个要求独立第三方 AI 安全审计的美国州。为其他州和潜在的联邦监管设立了模板。创建了其他司法管辖区可以采用的合规基础设施（审计师资格标准、报告机制）。

description.en: Compliance costs for covered companies: independent audits, safety incident reporting systems, and potential fines. Estimated impact on R&D expenditure for frontier labs.
description.zhHans: 受覆盖公司的合规成本：独立审计、安全事故报告系统以及可能的罚款。对前沿实验室研发支出的预估影响。

description.en: Whistleblower protections and incident reporting requirements may surface safety issues that would otherwise remain hidden, improving overall industry safety posture.
description.zhHans: 举报人保护和事故报告要求可能暴露原本会被隐藏的安全问题，改善整体行业安全态势。

text.en: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signed the AI Safety Measures Act (SB 315) on July 6, 2026, requiring independent third-party safety audits for AI developers with >$500M annual revenue.
text.zhHans: 伊利诺伊州长 JB Pritzker 于2026年7月6日签署了 AI 安全措施法案（SB 315），要求年收入超过 5 亿美元的 AI 开发者进行独立第三方安全审计。

text.en: The law requires covered companies to report critical safety incidents to the state within 72 hours and establishes fines of up to $1M (first violation) and $3M (subsequent).
text.zhHans: 该法律要求受覆盖公司在 72 小时内向州政府报告严重安全事故，并设定最高 100 万美元（首次违规）和 300 万美元（后续违规）的罚款。

text.en: The law represents the most prescriptive state-level AI regulation in the US, filling a void left by federal inaction.
text.zhHans: 该法律代表了美国最精细的州级 AI 监管，填补了联邦不作为留下的空白。

text.en: First US state to mandate independent third-party AI safety audits. Sets a template for other states and potentially federal regulation. Creates a compliance infrastructure (auditor qualification standards, reporting mechanisms) that other jurisdictions can adopt.
